_comment: Unary COSE vectors (ADR 0006 §§3-5, and the 2026-09-24 decisions on cratestack#1005: audience in the AAD, Cratestack-Nonce for unsigned requests). Hex throughout. Payload: payment-fixture.json; keys: keys.json. `to_be_signed` is the logical Sig_structure / MAC_structure, even where the implementation hashes it incrementally. Every `negative` vector must be refused (401 unauthenticated) by a verifier holding exactly `verifier_keys`, at `verifier_now`.

negative.name: neg-esp256-high-s
negative.why: the valid request's ESP256 signature with s replaced by n - s: it verifies mathematically, but only low-s is accepted, so each message has one encoding

negative.name: neg-hmac-64-bit-tag-for-a-256-256-key
negative.why: a valid HMAC 256/64 (alg 4) request; the verifier's key for this secret is configured for HMAC 256/256 only

negative.name: neg-kid-7-bytes
negative.why: correctly signed, but the kid is 7 bytes, not 8

negative.name: neg-kid-9-bytes
negative.why: correctly signed, but the kid is 9 bytes, not 8

negative.name: neg-kid-of-another-key
negative.why: signed by ed25519_other under ed25519's kid; the verifier holds both keys, and only a key whose own kid is the header's may verify

negative.name: neg-wrong-audience
negative.why: a valid request sealed for audience "payments", opened by the service "ledger"

negative.name: neg-kid-in-unprotected-header
negative.why: a valid request with {4: kid} added to the unprotected header, which must be empty

negative.name: neg-alg-minus-8
negative.why: correctly signed Ed25519 under the deprecated polymorphic alg -8 (RFC 9864)

negative.name: neg-trailing-byte
negative.why: a valid request followed by one extra byte

negative.name: neg-response-to-another-get
negative.why: a signed response to an unsigned GET carrying one Cratestack-Nonce, presented as the answer to a GET of the same URL with another nonce
